name: MLX-Serve
description: David Dalcu will be presenting on an extremely cool Open Source project he started called MLX-Serve. MLX-Serve is software you can use to run LLMs on your Mac using MLX and metal to accelerate your performance. MLX-Serve and MLX-Core can be used for not only running LLMs locally, but for creating and running AI Agents. MLX-Serve is written in Zig, and David will also talk about why he chose Zig over other system programming languages. You won't want to miss this presentation.
